meta.name: Kauriburir Mandir
meta.description:
When a mysterious curse threatens the woman he once loved, astrologer Bhabataran enters a haunted wilderness where an ancient cult worships a bloodthirsty deity. As a forbidden ritual draws near, he must confront a terrifying legacy buried for centuries.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: Bhabishyodbani
videos.overview: When fate brings the past back to his life, Bhabataran finds himself drawn towards a mystery beyond his understanding.

videos.title: Obhishapto Mondir
videos.overview: As Bhabataran investigates Golok Pushpa, a mysterious encounter leaves him with more questions than answers.

videos.title: Golok Pushpo
videos.overview: As the truth behind Golok Pushpa emerges, Bhabataran discovers that Anirban holds the key to breaking an ancient curse.

videos.title: Kauriburi
videos.overview: With the new moon approaching, Bhabataran and Madhuri race to find Anirban, unaware of the danger closing in.

videos.title: Kalbhairab
videos.overview: A 250-year-old curse binds Parag to a decaying body, while Bhabataran faces the wrath of the forest stranger.

videos.title: Ontim Orghyo
videos.overview: Love, sacrifice, and divine power shape the final battle as Bhabataran fights to save Madhuri from Boro Deuri's grasp.
